name: Emiya Kiritsugu
source:
[url=/c15]Shirou's[/url] foster father and his savior from the aftermath of the massive Fuyuki fire.
[spoiler]Prior to his fateful meeting with Shirou, Kiritsugu was notorious as the "Magus Killer," a freelancer who would hunt down heretical magi. He was also a Participant in the Fourth Holy Grail War[/spoiler]
